run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the discussion group CC'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom --cc flags to add additional reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the Google Mock group to the CC list
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional CC groups or different upload scripts
summarize_main: summarize the main function that parses CLI args, modifies the CC flag, and invokes upload.py via os.execv
